description: Literature ledger for potential livestock comparator datasets in CSLI. This file contains no numeric observation panel and is not a negative-control dataset.
rationale: The cited studies can motivate future acquisition of station-level livestock data. They cannot estimate a livestock-versus-dog/human contrast: no row-level observations, compatible geography, RF measurements, collection metadata, or selection covariates are held in this repository.

sources.citation: Wahl RL, Reif JS. Temporal trends in bull semen quality: a comparative model for human health? Environ Res. 2009;109(3):273-280.
sources.conclusion: The publication reports changing trends over time and explicitly notes methodological inconsistencies. This ledger does not hold its numeric series or any RF measurement.

sources.citation: Karoui S et al. Time trends, environmental factors and genetic basis of semen traits collected in Holstein bulls under commercial conditions. Anim Reprod Sci. 2011;124(1-2):40-50.
sources.conclusion: No systematic time trends observed except post-thawing motility, which increased due to improved freezing-thawing protocols. Heritability estimates moderate (0.16-0.22).

sources.citation: Hensel B, Henneberg S, Schröter F, Hürland M, Osmers JH, Geissendörfer S, Lautner M, Jung M, Schulze M. Temporal trends in porcine and bovine semen characteristics: A retrospective long-term analysis of semen production data. Anim Reprod Sci. 2026;286:108093. Epub 2025 Dec 25.
sources.sites: one German artificial-insemination centre per species

bull.reported_direction: sperm concentration, total sperm motility and sperm output increased; ejaculate volume decreased

boar.reported_direction: sperm concentration, total sperm motility and sperm output increased; ejaculate volume decreased

sources.note: The PubMed abstract was verified on 2026-08-19. It supplies publication-level counts, periods and reported directions only; no local full text, table, row-level data, station metadata or RF measurement is held. These aggregates must not be used as a numeric time series or exposure control.

blocking_reasons: Publication summaries are not a year-by-site panel.
RF exposure was not measured or reported for a matched comparison.
Genetic selection, collection/freezing protocols and station management are major unmeasured confounders.
